replenishment_policy.instruction: Add new todo tasks ONLY when the pool falls below minimum_todo_tasks. Focus on IntelliTrader (C# crypto trading bot) evolution: improving trading strategies, adding exchange integrations, fixing bugs, and improving the Web dashboard. Read docs/trends.md for inspiration when replenishment is needed.

autonomous_loop_policy.selection_rule: Choose the first todo task that is not blocked by high/critical risk.
autonomous_loop_policy.anti_stall_rule: Never ask the user for the next task while safe low/medium-risk tasks can be generated from IntelliTrader source, failing CI, or TODO comments.
autonomous_loop_policy.failure_rule: If CI fails, prioritize a fix task for the failure before starting new features.

tasks.title: Analyze IntelliTrader architecture and define evolution goals
tasks.description: Perform a deep scan of the C# codebase in IntelliTrader directories. Identify core components, exchange integrations, and trading rules. Create a new document `magda_agent_system/docs/intellitrader_evolution.md` outlining the findings and future improvements.
acceptance: magda_agent_system/docs/intellitrader_evolution.md exists
The document describes main C# modules and current state of the bot

tasks.title: Audit existing trading strategies for potential improvements
tasks.description: Review C# files in `IntelliTrader.Trading/Models` and `IntelliTrader.Rules/`. Look for inefficiencies or missing safety checks in Buy/Sell trailing logic. Propose specific tasks to improve these strategies.
acceptance: New tasks related to strategy improvements are added to agent_tasks.json

tasks.title: Plan Web Dashboard enhancements
tasks.description: Analyze `IntelliTrader.Web/` project. Review current views and controllers. Identify opportunities to add more real-time stats or improved log visualization. Document the plan in `magda_agent_system/docs/web_enhancements.md`.
acceptance: magda_agent_system/docs/web_enhancements.md exists with a list of proposed features

tasks.title: Optimize historical balance calculation in Web Dashboard
tasks.description: Refactor `HomeController.Stats` in `IntelliTrader.Web/` to use an O(N) running total algorithm instead of the current O(N^2) approach for historical balance calculation.
acceptance: The calculation logic in HomeController.Stats is updated to linear complexity
Performance improvement verified for large trade logs

tasks.title: Complete Binance order placement implementation
tasks.description: Implement `PlaceOrder`, `CancelOrder`, and `GetOrderDetails` in `BinanceExchangeService.cs`. Address TODOs related to mapping internal models to ExchangeSharp models.
acceptance: BinanceExchangeService successfully places real or test orders via ExchangeSharp
Model mapping between IOrder and ExchangeOrderRequest is complete

tasks.title: Implement spread-aware trailing safety checks
tasks.description: Integrate `TrailingSafetyOptions` into `TradingTimedTask`. Modify trailing logic to pause or stop trailing when market spread exceeds a configurable threshold, preventing losses due to slippage.
acceptance: Trailing logic respects MaxTrailingSpread setting
Tests verify that trailing pauses during high spread events

tasks.title: Refactor RulesService for better extensibility
tasks.description: Decompose the monolithic `CheckConditions` method in `RulesService.cs` into smaller, rule-specific evaluator classes (e.g., PriceEvaluator, SignalEvaluator).
acceptance: RulesService uses a registry of condition evaluators
Unit tests confirm that existing rule conditions still work correctly

tasks.title: Decompose TradingTimedTask into specialized processors
tasks.description: Extract buy, sell, and DCA logic from the large `TradingTimedTask.cs` into separate processors to improve maintainability and testability.
acceptance: TradingTimedTask delegates logic to specialized components
The main loop remains stable and passes existing integration tests

tasks.title: Export Magda skills as MCP-compliant tools
tasks.description: Inspired by June 2026 AI trends: Implement a module to export existing Magda skills (e.g., search, execute_code) as Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, enabling interoperability with other agentic systems.
acceptance: Skills can be successfully exported in MCP JSON-RPC format
Validation script confirms compliance with MCP tool specification

tasks.title: Implement Online RL for trading parameter optimization
tasks.description: Develop an OpenClaw-RL inspired feedback loop that adjusts trading parameters like `BuyTrailing` and `SellMargin` based on the success of completed trades stored in episodic memory.
acceptance: Agent can propose parameter adjustments after trade analysis
Adjustment history is tracked and evaluated for long-term improvement

tasks.title: Multi-agent strategy backtesting with isolation
tasks.description: Utilize Claude SDK Agent Teams and git worktree isolation to run parallel backtesting of multiple trading strategies. Each sub-agent operates in its own worktree to avoid configuration conflicts.
acceptance: Parallel backtesting runs in isolated worktrees
Results are aggregated and compared by the lead evaluator agent
